svg.title: Connections across six Charles River processes
svg.desc: Connections across six Charles River processes. Customer demand supports goods sales and design services. Purchasing supplies goods and manufacturing components, manufacturing supplies finished goods, payroll supports labor, and each process contributes to finance and period-end explanation. This is a conceptual dependency map of six business processes, not a serial company-wide workflow or a diagram of foreign keys.
